title: Flow Forge: Pipe Puzzle Game
release_notes: Initial release with 30 handcrafted levels across five chapters, rotate-to-connect pipe mechanics (including splitters, bolted and decoy pipes, cross-overpass, and multi-fluid routing), offline play, hints, undo, restart, star ratings, coins, and ad settings that start after level 10. Optional Remove Ads and coin packs included.
full_description:
Logic puzzles offline you can play anywhere, featuring precise pipe routing and tile rotation.

Build working paths by rotating straight and elbow pipes to guide fluids into matching drains. Every move is deliberate: some pipes are bolted, some are decoys, and splitters can feed several drains—use careful logic to earn stars and coins.

What’s inside
• 30 levels across 5 chapters: Workshop Basics (1–6), Factory Floor (7–12), Pressure Plant (13–18), Color Lab (19–24), Refinery Riddles (25–30)
• Mechanics evolve as you progress: rotate pipes, handle drain mouths and several drains, avoid decoy pipes, manage bolted pipes, use splitter tees, route two fluids, navigate cross-overpass “+”, and master three fluids
• Star rating per level based on your solution quality; replay anytime to improve
• Helpful tools: hints, undo, and restart are available when you need them
• Sound and haptics settings let you tune feedback to your preference
• Plays fully offline; progress is stored on your device only

Fair monetization
• No banner before level 5
• First interstitial after level 10; then at most one every 4 levels
• Rewarded ads only when you choose
• Optional IAP: Remove Ads, Pile of Coins, Chest of Coins (no loot boxes)

Why you’ll enjoy it
• Clean, readable grids focused on deduction and planning
• Each chapter introduces a new twist so solutions stay fresh without complexity creep
• Designed for touch: tap to rotate tiles with satisfying haptic feedback

Made for puzzle fans
• A modern pipe puzzle game built for thoughtful play
• Classic flow puzzle logic with clear rules and single-goal layouts
• Rotate tile puzzle fans will appreciate the focus on reasoning over speed

If you enjoy a pipe puzzle, water pipe puzzle layouts, or a flow puzzle that rewards planning, Flow Forge delivers compact challenges you can pick up anytime. Download now and start forging the perfect route.
short_description: Rotate pipes and route every fluid home: 30 handcrafted offline logic puzzles.
